name: Day Camps@The J (Summer@The J)
description_short: A day camp run by the Stamford JCC on a 15-acre campus for children aged 3 through grade 8. It offers athletic and creative arts instruction, Shabbat activities, and programming that changes as campers get older.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: The Stamford JCC - Summer at The J

warnings: This is the JCC's main summer page. It covers several programs: Day Camps (age 3–grade 8), Performing Arts (age 3–grade 8), Basketball camps (grades 2–8), and Summer Fun (12 months–3 years). This listing covers Day Camps@The J only.
Prices weren't on the page itself, only in the linked PDF: https://www.stamfordjcc.org/summeratthej/clientuploads/DayCamps/DayCamps2027_EarlyBirdRates.pdf
Early Bird Rates are valid through Tuesday, Dec. 15 (2026).
The Summer Fun Loyalty Rates mentioned (through Monday, Sept. 28) have already expired.
